 "data": "erDiagram
 USERS ||--o{ BOOKINGS : \"places\"
 USERS }|--|| ROLES : \"assigned\"
 FLOOR_MAPS ||--|{ DESKS : \"contains\"
 DESKS ||--o{ BOOKINGS : \"reserved_for\"
 BOOKINGS ||--o| CHECK_INS : \"generates\"
 BOOKINGS ||--o{ NOTIFICATIONS : \"triggers\"

 USERS {
 bigint user_id PK
 string full_name
 string email UK
 string password_hash
 bigint role_id FK
 timestamp created_at
 }

 ROLES {
 bigint role_id PK
 string role_name
 string description
 }

 FLOOR_MAPS {
 bigint floor_id PK
 string floor_number
 string building_name
 int total_capacity
 boolean is_active
 }

 DESKS {
 bigint desk_id PK
 bigint floor_id FK
 string desk_code UK
 string desk_type
 boolean has_monitor
 boolean is_accessible
 }

 BOOKINGS {
 bigint booking_id PK
 bigint user_id FK
 bigint desk_id FK
 timestamp start_time
 timestamp end_time
 string status
 string qr_token UK
 timestamp created_at
 }

 CHECK_INS {
 bigint checkin_id PK
 bigint booking_id FK
 timestamp scanned_at
 string terminal_id
 boolean verification_passed
 }

 NOTIFICATIONS {
 bigint notification_id PK
 bigint booking_id FK
 string recipient_email
 string channel
 string status
 timestamp sent_at
 }",
 "config": null
